source_interpretation.greenlet: 58 source/build files scanned in verified 3.5.5 sdist; all 55 installed C/C++ source/header files with sdist counterparts exactly match. C++ vectors hold OwnedObject, PyGreenlet* and ThreadState*, not bool. Includes algorithm/iostream but source calls std::find and std::min, emits diagnostic ostream output, no std::search/parallel/PBDS/bitset/charconv/fstream. Object-specific new routes to PythonAllocator or malloc; ordinary allocator import _Znwm, no aligned overload. Wheel compiler comment GCC14.2.1 RedHat, not installed Debian gcc14-base package.
source_interpretation.protobuf: Matching 7.36.0 sdist setup constructs google._upb._message from C source globs (google/protobuf, python, upb, utf8_range), language=c; 226 C/header/build files scanned and zero C++ source files or affected C++ feature matches. Matching official binary wheel exactly equals retained _message.abi3.so. It has libstdc++ DT_NEEDED but zero undefined mangled C++ symbols, consistent with link-time dependency rather than use of seven features. Cannot equate DT_NEEDED with exploit.
source_interpretation.other_extensions: Every retained ELF inspected, including 37 under opt and wheel-bundled psycopg libraries. Only three direct libstdc++ dependencies: greenlet runtime, greenlet test C++ extension and protobuf upb. No wheel-bundled libstdc++ ELF copy found. C/Rust native modules depend on libgcc independently; that does not make libgcc implement libstdc++ CVEs.
